Historical full-card image of [[Execution Arena (Pit) (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith) (Original)|Execution Arena (Pit)]], matching the [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
